title: ScrollingFrame
summary: A Frame that scrolls: content larger than the visible area scrolls via CanvasSize. Modern setups use AutomaticCanvasSize plus UIListLayout/UIGridLayout so the canvas grows with content.

properties.name: CanvasSize
properties.description: The scrollable area's total size. Must be bigger than the frame to scroll.

properties.name: AutomaticCanvasSize
properties.description: Auto-grows the canvas to fit content (X, Y, XY, or None) — the modern default choice.

properties.name: CanvasPosition
properties.description: Current scroll position (writable to scroll programmatically).

properties.name: ScrollingDirection / ScrollBarThickness / VerticalScrollBarInset
properties.description: Scroll axis, bar size, and inset behavior.

explanation.whatItIs: The scrollable window: inventories, chat logs, shop lists — anything taller than the screen.
explanation.whyItExists: Screens are finite; content isn't. Scrolling frames bridge that.
whenToUse: Inventories, leaderboards, shop item lists, chat
Any vertical list of dynamic children (with UIListLayout)
whenNotToUse: When content always fits — plain Frame
For paging UIs — consider pagination buttons instead
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
ScrollingFrame (the window)
   │ CanvasSize = total scrollable area
   ▼
UIListLayout + children
AutomaticCanvasSize=Y → canvas auto-grows as items appear
```
tips: AutomaticCanvasSize = Y + UIListLayout = zero manual canvas math
Scroll to bottom: CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, CanvasSize.Y.Offset)
commonMistakes: Manual CanvasSize forgotten while adding items dynamically
Children anchored absolutely AND list layout — pick one layout model

examples.title: Auto-growing list
examples.code:
local list = script.Parent   -- ScrollingFrame
list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Parent = list

local function addItem(text)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 30)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = text
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.LayoutOrder = #list:GetChildren()
    label.Parent = list
end

for i = 1, 30 do addItem("Entry " .. i) end
